notify.title: Tell me when it is back
notify.intro: This item is sold out. Leave your number and we will send you one message when it is available again.
notify.pickVariant: Please choose the option you are waiting for.
notify.mobileHint: For example 01712345678. We use it only for this message.
notify.signedIn: You are signed in, so we will message the number on your account.
notify.success: Thank you. We will message you when it is back.
notify.already: You are already on the list for this item. We will message you when it is back.
notify.successGuest: You will get one message, to the number you gave. You can opt out of any message with its link.
notify.successCustomer: You will get one message, to the number on your account.

errors.inStock: Good news: this item is in stock now. You can order it.
errors.limit: This number is already waiting for the most items we allow. We will message you when one of them is back.
errors.contact: Please enter a valid mobile number.
errors.notFound: We could not find that option. Please choose one and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests from your connection. Please wait a little and try again.
errors.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.missingTitle: This link has no unsubscribe code
unsubscribe.missingBody: Open the unsubscribe link from the message you received, or copy the whole link.
unsubscribe.invalidTitle: This unsubscribe link is not valid
unsubscribe.invalidBody: The link is damaged, cut short or changed. Open the link from your message again.
unsubscribe.contactHelp: If it still does not work, contact us and we will remove you by hand.
unsubscribe.confirmBody: We will stop sending you marketing messages on this channel. You can agree again any time in your account.
unsubscribe.orderMessages: Messages about your orders, payments and delivery are not marketing and will still reach you.
unsubscribe.doneBody: We will not send you more marketing messages by {channel}.
unsubscribe.alreadyBody: You do not get marketing messages by {channel}. Nothing was changed.
unsubscribe.failed: We could not unsubscribe you just now. Please try again.
unsubscribe.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a little and try again.
unsubscribe.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
